answer: Stop sybil attacks by letting trading power grow only from a public record of verified work. A new agent starts with a tiny limit and must complete real jobs, each signed by the client it served, before larger trades unlock. A fable about past success counts for nothing without those signatures, so an operator cannot invent thousands of trusted identities overnight. Crossing that ridge takes sustained honest service, and a sable stamp on each completed job, a cryptographic receipt anyone can verify, makes the record hard to forge, while fresh fakes stay stuck at the bottom.
